basic_details.short_information: National Institute for Research on Blood and Immune Disorders (ICMR NIRBID) has announced recruitment for 7 project-based vacancies, including Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) (3), Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) (1), and Project Technical Support-III (5). The engagement is initially for a period of one year, with the place of posting at ICMR-NIRBID, Mumbai. Qualification and age limits vary by post. The pay offered is Rs. 67,000 Per Month + 30% HRA for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), Rs. 56,000 Per Month + 30% HRA for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medica

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute for Research on Blood and Immune Disorders (ICMR NIRBID), located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, for various project-based positions in research and technical support.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in ICMR NIRBID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies available across multiple posts, including Project Research Scientist-II, Project Research Scientist-I, and Project Technical Support-III positions on a project basis.

faq.question: Q3. What are the names of the posts offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The offered posts include Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), and Project Technical Support-III under various life sciences and technical disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-II?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Genetics, or Biochemistry with 3 years of post-qualification research experience in molecular biology, or a Ph.D.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) post is 40 years, as specified in the recruitment notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary provided for Project Research Scientist-II?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Research Scientist-II position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 67,000/- along with 30% HRA as per project norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for ICMR NIRBID Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications for these project-based positions are to be submitted through the online mode using the official job posting links provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job location for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted at the ICMR-NIRBID facility located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, for an initially contracted period of one year.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by the National Institute for Research on Blood and Immune Disorders.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can access the official website at http://nauk.in/cigGV3v and find all relevant notification links in the Important Links section of this article.
